scripts.build: npm run build -w @dejotacode/site && npm run check -w @dejotacode/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run check -w @dejotacode/site && npm run check -w @dejotacode/api
scripts.deploy:production: npm run preflight:production && npm run deploy:api:production && npm run deploy:site:production
scripts.deploy:api:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config api/wrangler.jsonc --env production --remote && wrangler deploy --config api/wrangler.jsonc --env production
scripts.deploy:site:production: npm run build -w @dejotacode/site && wrangler pages deploy site/dist --project-name dejota-code --branch main
